title: QA agents profile
description: Project facts for the QA agents and scripts: paths, commands, ID rules, roles, API and UI exemplar files and rules, and live app guardrails.

conventions.description: Files with the project's prose conventions; agents read them before writing code.

contracts.description: API contracts, one markdown file per area.

contractFormat.description: The contract format specification the contract writer follows.

pages.description: Page objects, with components/ and dialogs/ inside.

userStories.description: User stories and acceptance criteria, input for UI scenarios.

testData.description: Test data: shared constants and factories.

coverageSummary.description: API coverage summary; generated, so it may not exist.

repeatSpec.description: Runs a spec several times in a row, to catch flaky tests.

validateContracts.description: Checks the contract folder against the contract format; may need an optional package.

diffContracts.description: Lists the endpoints added, removed and changed between the contracts and an OpenAPI spec ({spec}).

contractsFromOpenApi.description: Converts an OpenAPI spec ({spec}) into draft contracts.

inspectUi.description: Read-only page inspector: prints the data-test elements and accessibility tree of a page ({path}, relative to baseUrl).

ids.description: Scenario IDs are <PREFIX>-<number>, numbered across the whole layer (not per area) with a fixed number of digits; a scenario file lives in <layer>/<area>/<name>.yml.

layers.description: Layer folder name -> its ID prefix and number of digits, e.g. api: { prefix: API, digits: 4 } for API-0001.

areas.description: Area folder names under each layer, e.g. products.

fileNames.description: Layer -> regex for scenario file names (without .yml); {area} stands for the area folder name. Layers not listed accept any kebab-case name.

roles.description: Login roles; a scenario's role must be one of these.

exemplars.description: Existing files whose style new code copies.

cleanup.description: Where the cleanup fixture is defined.

testDataUtils.description: Helpers factories use, such as unique names.

knownIssue.description: Code that marks a test as hitting a known issue; {text} is the scenario's knownIssue.

rules.description: Agent-critical rules only; everything else is in project.conventions.

ui.description: Optional: only projects with UI tests have it.

exemplars.description: Existing files whose style new code copies.

component.description: A reusable part of a page.

dialog.description: A dialog, or the base class dialogs extend.

fixtures.description: Where page, component, dialog and flow fixtures are registered.

preconditionFixture.description: A fixture that starts a test on a prepared page.

knownIssue.description: Code that marks a test as hitting a known issue; {text} is the scenario's knownIssue.

rules.description: Agent-critical rules only; everything else is in project.conventions.

liveApi.description: Guardrails for anything that calls the live app, API or UI.

writes.description: Whether agents may run tests or checks that change data on the live app (API or UI).

dangerous.description: Calls that cause lasting harm, with how to avoid it.
